page_markdown:
Variable Frequency Digital Controller for Vibratory Feeder  
**SDVC31 Series**

## **Appendix D:** LED Displayed Characters Definition

| Controller | Displayed Character | 数码管符号图片 |
|---|---|---|
| `U` | Output Voltage | [[vcrop:44:0]] |
| `F` | Output Frequency | [[vcrop:44:1]] |
| `d` | Startup Delay Time of the Intelligent Photoelectric Sensor | [[vcrop:44:2]] |
| `C` | Shutdown Delay Time of the Intelligent Photoelectric Sensor | [[vcrop:44:3]] |
| `E` | Soft Startup | [[vcrop:44:4]] |
| `U-` | Shutdown D | [[vcrop:44:5]] |
| `d-` | Startup Delay Time of the NPN Switch Sensor | [[vcrop:44:6]] |
| `r1` | Logical Relation of the Intelligent Photoelectric Sensor | [[vcrop:44:7]] |
| `r2` | Logical Relation of the NPN Switch Sensor | [[vcrop:44:8]] |
| `r3` | Logical Relation of the Controlling Output | [[vcrop:44:9]] |
| `n` | Logical relation of the Control Signal | [[vcrop:44:10]] |
| `H` | Maximum Output Voltage | [[vcrop:44:11]] |
| `A` | Acceleration Index | [[vcrop:44:12]] |
| `P` | Waveform Index | [[vcrop:44:13]] |
| `88888` | Default Settings Restore | [[vcrop:44:14]] |

---

2018-11  -36-  SDVC31SMSEN_3.01
